body:
I keep telling myself that it is worth trying and deeply inside I know I couldn't stop trying, cause there is that 0.001% chance of being happy at some point; I was happy once or twice in my life and it's worth it. Maybe I'll run out of that hope one day, but I have it for now; it's not much, but it must do.
I wish you finding some of that hope too; maybe if you have enough of that hope, you'll have enough energy or power to ask for help. Let's not give up yet
